en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural railway station area. On the left is a one‑story station building on an embankment beside a stone railway bridge with an underpass road. On the right is a detached house with half‑timbered upper walls and a tiled roof. In the background are scattered houses and low hills. The caption in red German script at the top left reads "Neu-Coswig i. Sa. Bahnhof".
